item.blurb: GRAI Raises $9M Seed. GRAI raises $9M in seed funding led by Khosla Ventures and Inovo VC to develop AI-powered music remixing and social engagement software.
Project Suppliers Raises SAR 3.75M Pre-seed. Project Suppliers raises SAR 3.75 million in a pre-seed round to develop AI-powered cash flow management solutions for the construction and MEP sectors.
Notey Raises $3M Seed. Notey raises $3M in seed funding led by Tivoli Ventures and Malta Venture Capital to expand its music education and gamified practice platform.
Novele Raises $17M Series A. Novele raises $17 million Series A led by Boisei Labs to scale its autonomous AI-powered energy intelligence platform for commercial buildings.
Promenaut Raises $8.9M in Funding. Promenaut raises $8.9M in total funding to scale its enterprise agentic workforce platform and expand its reach within regulated industries.
